app.title: Video Player
app.description: Open and play video content routed by the Host resource service.

viewer.emptyLine: Open a video or drop a file here
viewer.keyboardHint: Shortcuts: Space play or pause, Left and Right seek, Up and Down change volume, F fullscreen, M mute
viewer.unsupportedPictureInPicture: Picture-in-picture is unavailable in the current host
viewer.unsupportedFullscreen: Fullscreen is unavailable in the current host

openFile.title: Open video
openFile.description: Open a video file from the system file picker.

saveCopy.title: Save copy
saveCopy.description: Save the current video as a copy.
saveCopy.ariaLabel: Save a copy of the current video

togglePlayback.title: Play or pause
togglePlayback.description: Toggle playback for the current video.

seekBackward.title: Back 5s
seekBackward.description: Seek the current video back by 5 seconds.

seekForward.title: Forward 5s
seekForward.description: Seek the current video forward by 5 seconds.

toggleMute.title: Mute or unmute
toggleMute.description: Toggle mute for the current video.

toggleFullscreen.title: Toggle fullscreen
toggleFullscreen.description: Enter or exit video fullscreen mode.

togglePictureInPicture.title: Toggle picture-in-picture
togglePictureInPicture.description: Enter or exit video picture-in-picture mode.

toggleMorePanel.title: Open or close more panel
toggleMorePanel.description: Show or hide the video info, subtitles, and audio panel.

disabled.pictureInPicture: Picture-in-picture is unavailable in the current host

empty.noSubtitles: This video does not expose switchable subtitle tracks.
empty.noAudioTracks: This video does not expose switchable audio tracks.

errors.missingPath: No playable video target was provided.
errors.loadFailed: The video failed to load or the current runtime cannot decode it.
errors.saveFailed: Unable to save the video copy.
errors.mediaNetwork: A network error occurred while loading the video.
errors.mediaDecode: The current runtime cannot decode this video.

status.samePath: The selected path is identical to the current source. No copy was written.
status.downloadFallback: The current source will be downloaded instead of copied.
